conclusion: Skeleton has enough major joints for large motion, but the current action design and local auto-weights cannot yet reproduce the approved references cleanly. Do not promote this experimental weight revision as finished.

motion_gaps.Walk: 12 frames/0.4 s. Camera-side silhouette barely changes in chest and pelvis; swing is mostly leg pivots, lacking the low predatory body travel and limb overlap of idle_walk.mp4. Foot-path derivative changes abruptly at stance/swing boundaries.
motion_gaps.Claw: Reference loads the torso, opens the attacking arm, steps into a wide body-driven slash, and drags claws past target. Current action mainly displaces an IK hand while feet and torso remain near neutral; reach target around f15 can be unreachable.
motion_gaps.Leap: Reference plants both claws low, compresses through limbs, launches horizontally, then catches the landing with paws and body compression. Current f23/f33 right hand target is beyond the unposed shoulder's reach, leaving the claw high above the floor.
motion_gaps.Hit: Only a slight upper-body twitch; 14 frame clip height varies about 4.5 cm. Needs a more legible but brief directional recoil with delayed head/claw reaction.
motion_gaps.Death: Reference collapses onto four supports and lowers the skull. Current final pose still has one claw/wrist high and little final load transfer; body floats over the floor in the review camera.

rig_details.positive: Pelvis, two spines, neck, head, both clavicles, upper/lower arm, hand, upper/lower leg, foot/toe, and four limb IK pairs are already present. Skull and distal claws can remain rigid. No new major bone is prerequisite for full-body blocking.
rig_details.asymmetry: Right clavicle/arm rest behind the body (-Y); left arm rests forward (+Y). This is a source-pose asymmetry, so mirrored keyframes are invalid. In a four-point pose, R_clavicle Z+60 degrees and X+30 degrees brings the right IK wrist to its target; neutral clavicle misses it by roughly 0.37 m in the independent pose.
rig_details.contact_calibration: Rig IK targets are wrists, not claw tips. In the independent crouch, floor contact measured at target wrist z about 0.58 m left and 0.49 m right. Setting wrist targets directly at z0.13 penetrates claws and can be unreachable.
rig_details.skin_weight_defects: Several right-wrist vertices have about 18-26% R_leg_upper influence despite being physically on the claw. Head/neck vertices carry clavicle influence. Under large pose changes, adjacent 1.5-3 cm edges diverge visibly; technical manifold/normalization QA alone did not detect this.

independent_stress.interpretation: Simple automatic cleanup improves bulk deformation but still leaves severe collar/neck stretches; requires manual weight paint or local topology/shoulder correction before extreme poses can be accepted.

next_actions: First create reference-matched blocking of Claw, Leap, Walk and Death with calibrated wrist/paw contact and torso weight transfer; review at game camera and side camera before spline polish.
Asymmetric right shoulder requires its own animated clavicle lead for low support. Keep attacking claw in FK for a broad arc, use IK only for planted support and contact.
Repair wrist and collar weights manually on the actual contact poses. Reject any pose with claw penetration, shoulder tearing, or >2x edge stretch near the visible silhouette.
Use the experimental blend only as a reproducible starting point, not as an approved rig or Unity export.
